sample_size_budget.stopping_rule: Stop after fourteen contract rows, four controls for each of seven gates, five bounded dispositions, and four primary requests.

source_rows.input_needs: released event prefixes, stored hypotheses, hidden change boundaries, and delayed labels
source_rows.method: actively distinguish stored constraint hypotheses before reactivation
source_rows.retirement_overlap: does not revive the V638 always-rebased archive or claim autonomous segmentation from supplied boundaries

source_rows.input_needs: query candidates, explicit released feedback, hypothesis votes, and per-query cost
source_rows.method: select released-feedback queries that distinguish surviving hypotheses and charge every query
source_rows.retirement_overlap: does not make unsupported constraints true by weight changes or reopen lossy predicate commits

source_rows.input_needs: authenticated source bytes, claim bytes, exact offsets, and independent held-out labels
source_rows.method: retain exact source and claim offsets with localized held-out error categories
source_rows.retirement_overlap: keeps external-text scorers and self-certified extraction retired

source_rows.input_needs: matched durable event traces, representation bytes, operation counts, and storage semantics
source_rows.method: decompose durable event cost across lookup, update, validation, transfer, and commit tails
source_rows.retirement_overlap: does not transfer custom Ising hardware speed claims to host storage work

source_rows.input_needs: usable extraction training evidence and an available target device
source_rows.method: defer a new KAN or custom Ising architecture until extraction yields usable evidence
source_rows.retirement_overlap: preserves the unavailable-custom-chip and failed small-graph parallel-update boundaries
